title: S$^2$-MAS: A Society-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation Framework with 500 Million Household Persona Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27746v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulating economic responses at society scale requires agents whose decisions reflect household circumstances and the effects of earlier actions. We introduce S$^2$-MAS, a society-scale multi-agent simulation framework built on 500 million synthetic household personas grounded in real-survey data. Its Genese engine separates decisions from state updates, while reusable financial scenarios and application ledgers track consumption, cash, debt and payments. FinL-mlx, a compact decision model trained with SFT + RLCD on 2.93 million examples, achieves 74.55% accuracy and 38.37% question-macro F1 in consumer financial-choice scenarios, outperforming Jev 1.13 and GLM-5.3-Flash on both measures. We evaluate eight financial task families and simulate 12 million distinct household agents in paired purchase-funding conditions. translated_title: S²-MAS：一个拥有5亿家庭角色智能体的社会规模多智能体仿真框架
translated_abstract: 在社会尺度上模拟经济反应，需要智能体的决策既能反映家庭自身状况，又能反映先前行动带来的影响。我们提出了S²-MAS，这是一个社会规模的多智能体仿真框架，构建于基于真实调查数据的5亿个合成家庭角色（persona）之上。其Genese引擎将决策与状态更新相分离，同时通过可复用的金融场景与应用账本来追踪消费、现金、债务和支付情况。FinL-mlx是一个紧凑的决策模型，使用SFT + RLCD在293万个样本上训练而成，在消费者金融选择场景中达到74.55%的准确率和38.37%的问题宏平均F1值，在两项指标上均优于Jev 1.13和GLM-5.3-Flash。我们评估了八个金融任务族，并在配对的购买融资条件下模拟了1200万个不同的家庭智能体。实验表明，同时提高购买目标和获批信用额度会增加消费，且不同年龄段的反应存在差异……
tldr: 该论文提出了S²-MAS社会规模多智能体仿真框架，基于真实调查数据构建5亿个家庭角色智能体，并配备专用紧凑决策模型FinL-mlx，能够在大规模仿真中刻画家庭金融决策及信用额度等政策变化对消费行为的差异化影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces S$^2$-MAS, a society-scale multi-agent simulation framework with 500 million survey-grounded household persona agents and a compact decision model FinL-mlx, enabling large-scale simulation of household financial decisions and their differentiated consumption responses to policy changes such as raised credit limits.
